hooks.name: Auto-Document Changes
hooks.description: When a file is saved in the roadiq project, remind the agent to update PROJECT_STATUS.md with what changed

action.prompt: A file in the RoadIQ project was just saved. After completing the current task, update PROJECT_STATUS.md to reflect what changed. Keep the document current with: which files exist, what they do, what's working, and what's the current architecture (server.py Flask backend + static/index.html frontend + Bedrock AI + Celonis locations + Databricks data). Do NOT interrupt the user's current work — just update the doc silently at the end.
